_comment: ngsolve thermal_structural#2 (the thermal RHS prefactor is 3K = 3*lam+2*mu, not 2*mu). Verified 2026-08-03 on NGSolve 6.2.2604, unit_square maxh=0.3, VectorH1(order=2), rigid modes removed with a 3-component NumberSpace, E=210 GPa nu=0.3 alpha=1.2e-5 dT=100. The (3*lam+2*mu) RHS reproduces the exact plane-strain free expansion (1+nu)*alpha*dT = 1.560000e-03 to 6 digits; the 2*mu RHS gives exactly (1-2nu)*alpha*dT = 4.800000e-04. Measured error factor 3.2500 == (1+nu)/(1-2nu) in closed form, confirming the corrected '~3x for metals' figure and refuting the retired '~30-100x'. Both variants leave the free body stress-free (residual < 4e-12), which is exactly why the mistake is silent: only the STRAIN magnitude reveals it.
